    chk('IS &',list(S&set([1,2,3])),[x for x in U if x in (1,2,3)])
    chk('IS -',list(S-set([1,2])),[x for x in U if x not in (1,2)])

        if U: i=R.randrange(len(U)); chk('IS rm idx',S[i],U[i]); chk('IS index',S.index(U[i]),i)
        chk('IS pop',S.pop() if U else None, U.pop() if U else None)
    B=lu.BarrelList(L); M=list(L)
    for op in range(10):
        c=R.randrange(4)
        if c==0: j=R.randint(-20,20); B.insert(j,99); M.insert(j,99)

    chk('BL',list(B),M)

    l=cu.LRU(max_size=3); od=[]
